correctness.rationale: For any finite simple tree with n>=3, the hull of a >=2-edge edge-general-position set has all its leaf edges selected and no internal selected edge; conversely leaf edges of a connected >=2-edge subtree are geodesically in position. A set is inclusion-maximal exactly when every hull nonleaf vertex has all T neighbors inside, since any unsaturated internal vertex offers a valid leaf-edge extension, and every other outside edge attaches beyond a leaf, making an existing selected edge interior. Saturated subtree leaf degree is 2+sum_internal(deg_T(v)-2). The full star at a vertex of minimum nonleaf degree attains lower number; whole T achieves leaf upper number. Pure iff path or star. Exact coefficients for two-leaf subpaths along maximal deg2 chains and maximum arms, plus rooted recurrences, follow from these bijections. Independent direct geodesic checks on P6, a six-vertex double-star and an asymmetric seven-vertex tree give 10z², 2z³+z⁴, 6z²+4z³. Finite tests corroborative only.
